title: Patient Accounting Posting Standard: Charges Eligible for the Patient Hardship Discount Program
content:
**Standard 1 — Status.** A Patient Hardship Discount Program discount is applied only under a determination in approved status. The status of the determination under which the discount is applied, as shown in the program's records for that determination, decides.

**Standard 2 — After insurance.** Where the level applies the discount only to the patient's responsibility after insurance, the discount applies only once the payer has adjudicated the visit.

**Standard 3 — Eligible charges.** Eligible charges are patient-responsibility charges on Insured Plans of Care whose payer program allows patient balances to receive a Patient Hardship Discount Program adjustment, with a visit date from the level's retroactive coverage period in calendar days before the application date through the expiry date. Within that:

| Kind of charge | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Copays | Discounted only where the level discounts copays |
| Time-of-service deductible estimates | Never discounted while the level does not discount deductible estimates |
| Self-Pay Visit Package prices | Never discounted while the level does not discount Self-Pay Visit Package prices |
| Charges of Medicare patients | Discounted where the level allows the discount for patients with Medicare coverage |
| Charges already in a Patient Payment Plan | Discounted where the level discounts payment plan balances; the Patient Payment Plan balance is then reduced instead |
| Charges already with the collection agency | Recalled and discounted only where the level recalls balances from collections |

**Standard 4 — Charges posting during the period.** Where the level discounts visits during the eligibility period, charges posted during the period are discounted as they post.

**Standard 5 — What a discount posts.** Each discounted charge is recorded as one discount entry referencing that charge, showing the date applied, the plan of care, the discount amount, the percentage applied (0 for a catastrophic cap discount) and whether the charge is still on the plan of care or already enrolled in a Patient Payment Plan. A charge still on the plan of care receives a hardship discount adjustment on the Insured Plan of Care; a charge already in a Patient Payment Plan receives a hardship discount adjustment to that plan's balance.

### Visit-date window (hypothetical dates)

An application dated 2026-05-01, at a level whose retroactive coverage reaches 240 calendar days before the application date, with an expiry date of 2026-10-31:

| Visit date | Within the window |
|---|---|
| 2025-09-02 | No — 241 days before the application date |
| 2025-09-03 | Yes — 240 days before the application date |
| 2026-10-31 | Yes — the expiry date |
| 2026-11-01 | No — after the expiry date |

### Points of judgement

- *A determination is still pending.* No discount is applied under it (Standard 1).
- *A visit's claim is with the payer and not yet adjudicated, at a level that discounts only after insurance.* The discount does not apply yet (Standard 2).
